title: 2.1 Eubacteria
description: True bacteria: prokaryotic structure, cell wall, shapes, reproduction and metabolism. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Eubacteria?
options: Bacteria that lose crystal violet and take the counterstain
Bacteria that grow in environments where oxygen is absent
Bacteria that retain crystal violet stain in the Gram test
The domain of true bacteria with peptidoglycan cell walls
questions.correctAnswer: The domain of true bacteria with peptidoglycan cell walls

An organism that synthesises its own organic compounds
An organism whose cells lack a membrane-bound nucleus
questions.correctAnswer: An organism whose cells lack a membrane-bound nucleus
